name: Directional Backlight Autostereoscopic Rendering
aliases: 48-view 3D display with sequential LED switching and parallax barrier
definition: A technique using directional backlight mechanisms and high-speed LCD panels to generate optically distinct viewing regions in a time-multiplexed fashion, providing full resolution for each view.
summary: Directional Backlight Autostereoscopic Rendering generates full-resolution 3D by time-multiplexing directional backlight sources to decouple view generation from display optics, avoiding the resolution trade-offs of static parallax barriers.
